title: feat(plugin-chatbot): the plan card says how the build will land (objectui#12724)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HPPdgXnLU8SfcQmac3AzRouL)_

Clause-②: yes (the exported `ProposedPlanCard` gains the optional `posture`)

Closes #12724

## What

objectstack-ai/cloud declared `planCard.posture` on `propose_blueprint`'s envelope (cloud#2924 ruling A, cloud PR #3111, `f0ecef3a`): `{ mode: 'publish' | 'draft', liveRecords, line }`. objectui drew nothing from it yet. The plan card now draws `posture.line` (for example 「首次搭建直接上线；之后的修改先存草稿，由你发布」) as the **last item of the assumptions list**, where the AiBuild artboard draws it. A plan card without the key draws as before. If a plan has a posture but no assumptions, the section still renders and holds the posture line alone.

- `mapMessages.ts`: `ProposedPlanCard.posture?: { mode; line }`, lifted in `liftPlanCard` only when `mode` is a declared value and `line` is non-empty. `liveRecords` is already in the line, so it is not lifted.
- `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`: one `<li data-testid="proposed-plan-posture" data-posture={mode}>` after the assumptions.
- `fixtures/build-cards.schema.ts`: re-vendored verbatim at cloud `f0ecef3a`. The only change from the `f7ab9cc8` copy is `planCard.posture`, and cloud `main` `36b07fdf` has the same schema byte for byte.
- `buildCards.fixtures.ts`: `planEnvelope(lang, { posture: 'firstBuild' | 'draft' })`, built with cloud's own `postureFirstBuild` / `postureIntoLiveApp` wording.
- The docs paragraph in `content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`, and a changeset (`@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` minor).

## Why this closes #12724

The card's two remaining artboard rows have no producer key at cloud `main` `36b07fdf`, and no cloud card plans one:
- the plan card's 「确认后约 1 分钟搭好」 and 「也可以直接回复：…」
- the result card's subtitle 「应用已进启动台 · 包 … · 以下每一条都按方案核对过」

The maintainer ruled in the project thread on 2026-10-25 to drop both from the artboard rather than wait for cloud. This posture row was the last declared key still undrawn.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/`: 83 files, 795 tests, all passed, including the new `ChatbotEnhanced.planCardPosture-12724.test.tsx`. It covers zh and en first-build lines, the draft line, posture without assumptions, and two controls: no key, and an undeclared mode.
- `buildCards.contract-12724.test.ts` checks both new fixture payloads against the vendored schema.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` ✅. `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)
